logo.description: Surabhi Sauces official brand logo shown in the site header

business_description: An Indian food brand selling condiments including ketchups, mayonnaise, chutneys and pastes, pizza and pasta sauces, fruit jams, ginger-garlic paste, Indian ethnic condiments, and a Jain no-onion/no-garlic range.
business_model: Consumer packaged-food brand with a Shopify direct-to-consumer storefront and an offline distribution network serving households across India.
brand_aesthetic: Food-forward, bright and approachable ecommerce presentation using Poppins body copy, Fira Sans headings, red and green accents, product imagery, recipes, and direct shopping calls to action.

brand_voice.description: Warm, enthusiastic and culinary-led. Copy repeatedly frames products as ways to elevate everyday cooking, foregrounds flavour and purity, and closes with direct invitations to shop, discover, or try.
voice_patterns: Open with an active sensory verb such as indulge, savor, discover, or elevate.
Describe a familiar meal or cooking occasion before naming the product benefit.
Pair flavour language with concrete product facts or ingredient claims.
Use short, direct calls to action such as Shop All, Read More, or Add to Cart.
Use British/Indian spelling where present, including flavour and colours.
Use first-person plural for brand commitments and second person for cooking outcomes.

brand_values: No added colours or flavour enhancers

primary: Indian households buying sauces, condiments, pastes, and spreads
Home cooks seeking convenient flavour additions

competitor_alternative_categories: Fresh ginger and garlic prepared at home
primary_business_goal: Increase product discovery and online sales across Surabhi's condiment categories.
site_type: Shopify ecommerce store with recipe and blog content
